title: Claims Bulletin: Host Cancellation Timing and HostCover Lost-Income Settlements
content:
**Host Damage Protection (HostCover).** The cancellation timing share follows the host cancellation recorded on the host account for the cancelled booking (the booking for which the most recent calendar block for a host cancellation was placed on the listing): a cancellation the host initiated in the "more than 30 days" band settles the lost income at 50 percent, because a booking that far ahead could have been kept once repairs were done; one the host initiated in the "30 days to 48 hours" band at 80 percent; and a cancellation in the "under 48 hours" band, or one Roamhaven initiated, in full. The percentage applies to the lost income being settled, before any guest payment or deductible comes off it.

## Records read

- **The cancelled booking**: the stay named on the most recent calendar block that Listings records on the listing for a host cancellation.
- **The host cancellation**: the host cancellation that Host Accounts records for that stay, with its timing band and who initiated it (the host or Roamhaven).

| Initiated by | Timing band | Lost income settled at |
|---|---|---|
| the host | more than 30 days | 50 percent |
| the host | 30 days to 48 hours | 80 percent |
| the host | under 48 hours | in full |
| Roamhaven | any band | in full |

## Questions

**The host cancelled six weeks ahead; Host Accounts shows the "more than 30 days" band, initiated by the host. Lost income being settled is 1400.00. At what amount does it enter the settlement?** 700.00, at 50 percent. (Hypothetical.)

**Roamhaven cancelled the booking in the same band?** In full: 1400.00.

**The host cancelled the evening before check-in, "under 48 hours" band?** In full.
